decision.title: String representation
decision.summary: Strings are UTF-8 with a per-string ASCII-only flag for O(1) codepoint indexing, and the codepoint count and flag are computed at validation (refined by ).

body.p: UTF-8, with a per-string flag for ASCII-only content so codepoint indexing is O(1) in the common case. Codepoint count cached on first use. Confirmed at the Phase 0 gate, refined by : count and flag are computed when the string is validated, not cached later.
